input: Hem the new suit trousers before the event

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The deadline (when the event is) determines how much time is available and whether professional tailoring is even feasible.
Knowing the exact desired trouser length (break style or a specific measurement) determines what work needs to be done and avoids re-doing it.
Whether the user plans to do it themselves or take it to a tailor completely changes the steps, tools, and time required.
The fabric type of the trousers affects which hemming method is appropriate (hand stitch, machine, iron-on tape) and difficulty level.
If going to a tailor, knowing whether one has already been identified or if finding one is part of the task changes the first action.
The preferred hem finish (hand-sewn, blind hem, iron-on tape) affects the quality, permanence, and effort of the result.
Understanding how formal or polished the result needs to be (e.g. a one-off casual event vs. a wedding) sets the quality bar for the work.

gold.taskTitle: Hem suit trousers before upcoming event
gold.taskDescription: Shorten or finish the hem on a new pair of suit trousers in time for a specific event.

questions.title: When exactly is the event you need them for?
questions.description: Establish the hard deadline to determine how much time is available for hemming, whether by hand, machine, or professional tailor.

questions.title: What trouser length or break style do you want?
questions.description: Confirm the target finished length — e.g. no break, slight break, full break, or a specific measurement — so the correct amount of fabric is removed.

questions.title: Will you hem them yourself or use a tailor?
questions.description: Determine who is doing the work, as this drives every subsequent step including tools needed or appointments to book.

questions.title: What fabric are the trousers made from?
questions.description: Identify the material (e.g. wool, polyester blend, linen) since this affects which hemming method is suitable and how tricky the job will be.

questions.title: Do you already have a tailor or alterations shop in mind?
questions.description: Find out whether sourcing a tailor is part of the task, which would be the immediate next action if not already arranged.

questions.title: What type of hem finish do you want on the trousers?
questions.description: Clarify the preferred method — hand-sewn blind hem, machine stitch, iron-on hem tape, or turn-up/cuff — as this affects permanence, appearance, and effort.

questions.title: How formal or important is this particular event?
questions.description: Gauge the quality bar required — a quick fix for a casual event is very different from a polished finish needed for a wedding or job interview.
